_about: Locked MOSS-Image character sentences (24 Oct 2026; Juan chose Kiki and Byte, MOSS approved for poses). Prompt = sentence + style + 'The character is <pose>' + background. Same style as Pip (design/mascot/penguin_laptop_s3.png). Made with video_generation/scripts/make_moss.py (turbo, 1024x1024, seeds 1-3); jobs: video_generation/images/moss/oct24/jobs.json; review page: video_generation/images/moss/oct24/index.html.
style: Flat chunky mobile-app illustration style with rounded geometric shapes, no outlines, soft minimal flat shading with one shadow tone, polished and friendly.
background: Full body, centred, plain pure white background, no scenery, no text.
kiki: Kiki, a small chubby cartoon quokka girl with warm sandy-brown fur, a lighter cream muzzle and belly, small round ears with pink insides, big round dark brown eyes with white highlights, soft pink cheeks, a small dark brown button nose and a wide happy quokka smile, short rounded arms with small dark brown paws, short legs with dark brown feet, a short thick tail, wearing a coral-red t-shirt and big round orange headphones resting around her neck.
byte: Byte, a stocky cartoon wombat (an Australian wombat, not a bear): a low, wide, barrel-shaped body on very short thick legs, warm grey-brown fur, a wide flat-topped head that is broader than it is tall, small rounded ears set far apart on the sides of the head, a very broad flat dark nose pad covering the front of a short blunt snout, small round dark eyes with white highlights, soft pink cheeks, a calm friendly smile, short strong claws on his paws, no visible tail, wearing a navy t-shirt with a small green square on the chest. No round bear muzzle, no tall round bear ears.

Cute chubby proportions, big round eyes with white highlights, soft pink cheeks. poses.neutral: standing upright facing the viewer, arms relaxed at the sides, a gentle smile.
poses.waving: standing and waving hello with one paw raised high, a big friendly smile.
poses.pointing: standing and pointing to the right with one paw, as if showing something on a screen, smiling.
poses.thinking: standing with one paw on the chin, looking up thoughtfully, eyebrows raised.
